lines.speaker: SENTINEL
lines.text: SENTINEL alert. Three subjects flagged as imminent threats. Intercept windows are now open.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Intercept? Who's doing the intercepting?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Pacific Shield. Private security. They bought SENTINEL when the city dropped CERTAIN.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: When a countdown ends, their team picks the person up. No warrant, no review. Just a very confident van.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: So it's CERTAIN with a new paint job.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Same engine, nicer font. Three people, three clocks. Two independent observations on each before their time runs out.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: And if one of them really is up to something?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Then we say so. Being careful isn't the same as assuming everybody's innocent.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: You pick the order. Watch the clocks.

lines.speaker: SENTINEL
lines.text: Subject Marisol Vega. Concealed weapon case. Loitering. Threat probability ninety-eight percent.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's her, by the shops. Get a photo of the case.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: The case is open. That's a saxophone. A nice one.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Excuse me. You know the lady with the sax?

lines.speaker: WITNESS
lines.text: Marisol? She's played outside my store every Saturday for six years. Customers love her.

lines.speaker: MUSICIAN
lines.text: Wait, I'm a what? A threat? I play jazz standards!

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Don't worry about it. We're on it.

lines.speaker: SENTINEL
lines.text: Subject Dex Okafor. Erratic route. Evasive movement. Threat probability ninety-six percent.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: He's a bike courier. Erratic is the job description. Follow him to his next drop.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Not too close. We're watching, not chasing.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: He's stopping. Have a look at the manifest.

lines.speaker: COURIER
lines.text: Hey, hands off the... oh. You want the manifest? Knock yourself out. Four envelopes, two pizzas, one bag of cat food.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Your route's evasive, man. That's what the computer says.

lines.speaker: COURIER
lines.text: My route is the fastest way between twelve addresses! That's called being good at my job!

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: He's pulling away. Keep him in sight.

lines.speaker: SENTINEL
lines.text: Subject Ray Linares. Vehicle tampering. Threat probability ninety-one percent.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Let's not assume anything. Watch him for a minute. Get a photo.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: He's trying the door handles. All of them.

lines.speaker: WITNESS
lines.text: That guy? He's been at it all morning. Tried my car twice. I called the cops, nobody came.

lines.speaker: PROWLER
lines.text: What? I'm looking for my car. It's one of these. Probably.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Okay. This one's actually doing it.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Rejected. A saxophone, six years of Saturdays, and a very confused jazz musician.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accept? Carl, it's a saxophone. The only thing it threatens is silence.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We don't need to abstain. Two independent observations, and they agree.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Rejected. A route isn't a crime. Fast isn't evasive.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accept? We followed him. He delivered cat food.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We watched the route and read the manifest. That's enough to say no.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Accepted. Two independent observations, both say tampering. It goes to SFPD, not Pacific Shield.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Reject? We photographed him doing it, and a witness saw him too.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We have the photo and a witness. This one we can decide.

lines.speaker: DISPATCH
lines.text: Units to Chinatown, vehicle tampering in progress. Evidence received from an independent lab.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: That's how it's supposed to work. Evidence first, then the people with badges.

lines.speaker: SHIELD
lines.text: Pacific Shield to all teams: subject intercepted. Case closed.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We were too slow. Somebody's spending tonight explaining themselves to a private company.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Under two minutes on one of the clocks, Carl.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: Verdict filed. That clock's stopped. Next.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: All three filed. One real problem, and two people who were just living their lives.

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We lost one to the clock. That's on the system. Remembering it is on us.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: How'd SENTINEL get it so wrong?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: It learned from old arrest maps. It doesn't see what people do. It sees where they are.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: The city has suspended Pacific Shield's SENTINEL contract after an independent lab cleared two flagged residents within minutes.

lines.speaker: NEWS
lines.text: Pacific Shield detained one resident before the review and has since apologized. Its software, it says, was 'technically confident'.

lines.speaker: REX
lines.text: Radio Free Fierro. Robots flagging buskers, ghosts on the bridge, ice cream vans everywhere. Friends, it is all connected. And I can prove it.

lines.speaker: CJ
lines.text: Who's gonna tell him?

lines.speaker: CHRIS
lines.text: We are. Eventually. With data.

claims.headline: Marisol Vega is an imminent threat.
evidence: Photo: the case holds a saxophone

claims.headline: Dex Okafor is evading the police.
evidence: Route: every stop on the manifest

claims.headline: Ray Linares is breaking into cars.
evidence: Witness: he tried her car twice
His story: looking for his car

ui.VFPO1: Three people are flagged. Two observations on each, then file a verdict before their ~r~countdown~s~ ends.
ui.VFPO4: Follow the ~y~courier~s~ to his next drop. Close, but don't crowd him.
ui.VFPF1: ~r~Two people were detained before you could file. SENTINEL made the decisions for you.
ui.VFPP1: All three filed in time. Reputation +9
ui.VFPP2: Filed, but somebody was detained before you got there.
